basic_info.description: Just pack and move into this newly renovated four-bedroom, three-bathroom home with panoramic ocean views in Outer Sunset. It is within walking distance to Sunset Dunes, stores, restaurants, shops, Golden Gate Park, and other conveniences!  Remodeled for contemporary living, this home includes a large primary bedroom with a sitting area on the top level offering full ocean views. The main level features a spacious living room, dining area, newly remodeled kitchen with stainless appliances, and two bedrooms with ocean views. The lower floor has a fourth bedroom, a bathroom, a garage, and access to a multi-level backyard. Other features include a fireplace, hardwood floors, recessed lights, updated electrical system, seismic work, washer/dryer, and more. Must see to appreciate!
